page_review.title: Low-Poly PSX Style Industrial Metal Doors Pack
page_review.author: Icevanilla
page_review.description: A pack of 6 low-poly PSX-style industrial metal doors for utility, service and industrial environments, with clean, worn, rusty, reinforced and heavy variants.
page_review.download_modal_terms: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
page_review.visible_geometry: A row of industrial metal door variants including plain, windowed, worn and heavy leaves; the modeled Metal_Door_007 pair forms a double-leaf display and is excluded.
page_review.author_dependency_comment: The author says the model uses one texture atlas included with the FBX; local USDZ contains one atlas.

selected_source.operation: Keep only this source single-leaf group; no separate frame group is present in the stage. Inspect the grouped mesh for modeled frame surfaces before deciding preparation. Exclude the double-leaf display and other groups; preserve original meshes, UVs, texture and downloaded USDZ.

license_dependency_review: One 1024 x 256 base-color atlas is packaged in the CC BY USDZ; stage metadata matches the page author, CC-BY-4.0 and source URL. No separate texture terms were found.
local_geometry_review: One 1.021 x 2.125 m ornate metal leaf is modeled, with no source frame group for it. The pack single-door frame has about 0.843 m inner width, far below this leaf even after the 2% allowed fit. The required separately collidable frame is absent and the available pack frame is not size-compatible without substantial resizing or reconstruction.
